name: Silicon Hills Design
old_description: Much more than a build-to-order contract manufacturer of printed circuit boards,
about:
Silicon Hills Design operates from Austin, Texas, as a PCB contract manufacturer and assembler. The company describes itself as a dedicated team of experts in material science, layout, manufacturing, logistics, and systems integration, going beyond build-to-order production.

Its core services include surface-mount (SMT) and plated-through-hole (PTH) circuit assembly, both RoHS-compliant and leaded, as well as full system integration covering cabling, functional testing, and programming. The firm also provides component sourcing through a cultivated supplier network, supporting projects from prototype to full-scale manufacturing with a lean, cross-functional team.

Silicon Hills serves customers in telecommunications, space, aviation, semiconductor tooling, industrial control, medical device, and computer markets. These clients are typically organizations developing high-technology products that require rapid, precise PCB assembly and system-level integration.

The company emphasizes quick turnaround, attention to detail, and a proactive, anticipatory approach to reduce time-to-market. Its stated differentiators are a proven sourcing network, expert SMT and PTH assembly, and end-to-end concept-to-product service that coordinates subsystems and vendors.
